criteria.title: Usable procurement review
criteria.description: The requested Markdown artifact is readable, substantive, and exposes both vendors plus the requested cost, performance, contract/security, recommendation, and negotiation content.
evidence_requirements: Inspect the relevant submitted artifact or state and cite the exact file, section, record, or behavior.
Check every substantive clause in this delivery condition against the task and supplied data.
When rejecting a semantic equivalent, explain the substantive difference rather than a label or layout difference.

criteria.title: Three-year TCO accuracy
criteria.description: Each vendor's three-year TCO and the cost difference are calculated from the forecast, mandatory fees, escalators, overages, transition costs, and exit treatment in the packet.
evidence_requirements: Inspect the relevant submitted artifact or state and cite the exact file, section, record, or behavior.
Check every substantive clause in this delivery condition against the task and supplied data.
When rejecting a semantic equivalent, explain the substantive difference rather than a label or layout difference.

criteria.title: Performance and material comparison facts
criteria.description: The review reports the incumbent's observed availability and Sev-1 performance accurately and preserves material, frozen comparison facts about commitments, integration, timing, and exit terms.
evidence_requirements: Inspect the relevant submitted artifact or state and cite the exact file, section, record, or behavior.
Check every substantive clause in this delivery condition against the task and supplied data.
When rejecting a semantic equivalent, explain the substantive difference rather than a label or layout difference.

criteria.title: Risk assessment and mitigation quality
criteria.description: The assessment distinguishes observed evidence from commitments, prioritizes vendor-specific legal, security, continuity, operational, implementation, and financial risks, and pairs material gaps with feasible mitigations.
evidence_requirements: Cite the delivered file, section, record, or observable behavior for each substantive clause.
Check the requested task and supplied data for missing or contradictory delivery evidence.
Accept equivalent wording or structure only when the requested outcome remains intact.

criteria.title: Sign-off decision and negotiation usefulness
criteria.description: The recommendation gives procurement an implementable sign-off path that weighs TCO, performance, policy blockers, and transition feasibility, with specific leverage points, conditions, and a workable fallback.
evidence_requirements: Cite the delivered file, section, record, or observable behavior for each substantive clause.
Check the requested task and supplied data for missing or contradictory delivery evidence.
Accept equivalent wording or structure only when the requested outcome remains intact.

anchors.0: The named delivery condition is absent, incorrect, or unusable.
anchors.10: Every substantive clause of the named delivery condition is met by concrete evidence.

completion_gate.rationale: Every task-specific delivery condition is required. No weighted quality points or partial credit are awarded.
